How do toppers actually improve their UPSC Mains answer writing?

In this video, Santosh Sir explains the answer writing cycle that helped aspirants like AIR 3 Archit Dongre improve their Mains preparation.

The process is simple: Study a topic → Analyse its PYQs → Write an answer → Get it evaluated → Identify your gaps → Improve.

Because every aspirant has different weaknesses, personalised feedback is crucial to developing better answers.

Don’t just read. Write, get evaluated and improve.

snippet.description:
Feedback Mechanism in Endocrine System is a crucial topic in Class 12 Biology Chapter 16 that explains how your body maintains balance through hormonal control. This video is designed for Intermediate (FSc Part 2) students following the FBISE curriculum, Punjab Board, Sindh Board, and PCTB textbook standards.

In this comprehensive lesson, you'll learn:

✓ What feedback mechanisms are and their importance in homeostasis
✓ Negative feedback loops and how they maintain hormonal balance
✓ Positive feedback loops and their biological significance
✓ Examples of feedback mechanisms in the endocrine system
✓ How the pituitary gland, hypothalamus, and thyroid interact
✓ Real-world applications in maintaining body temperature and blood glucose

The endocrine system works like a smart control system—when hormone levels rise or fall, feedback mechanisms automatically adjust production to keep everything balanced. Understanding these mechanisms is essential for scoring well in your Class 12 Biology exams and competitive medical entrance tests.

This video breaks down complex concepts into simple, visual explanations perfect for students preparing for:
- FBISE Final Exams
- Punjab/Sindh Board Examinations
- Entry tests for medical colleges
- Competitive scholarship exams

Whether you're struggling with the concept or want a quick revision, this tutorial covers everything you need to know about feedback mechanisms in the endocrine system.

**Don't forget to:**

💬 Comment your questions below
📲 Share with classmates preparing for exams

snippet.description:
Properties of Determinants is a fundamental topic in Class 11 Maths Chapter 4 that every Intermediate student must master. In this comprehensive video, we explore the key properties of determinants and how they simplify complex calculations in linear algebra.

This lesson covers all essential properties including row and column operations, the effect of swapping rows or columns, properties of identical rows or columns, scalar multiplication, and how determinants behave under various transformations. Understanding these properties is crucial for solving determinant problems efficiently and forms the foundation for matrix theory in your FBISE, Punjab Board, Sindh Board, and other Pakistani examination boards.

Whether you're studying from the PCTB textbook, National Book Foundation materials, or following the National Curriculum of Pakistan, this video breaks down each property with clear explanations and practical examples. You'll learn how to apply these properties to evaluate determinants quickly, which saves time during your FSc Part 1 exams.

This video is perfect for:
• Class 11 and Intermediate students preparing for board exams
• Students studying Maths from any Pakistani board (FBISE, Punjab BISE, Sindh BSE, KPK, Balochistan, AJK)
• Anyone looking to strengthen their understanding of linear algebra and matrices
• Students seeking quick revision before tests and final exams

By the end of this lesson, you'll confidently solve determinant problems using these properties and understand the mathematical reasoning behind each one. Watch the complete video, take notes, and practice the examples we work through together.

Don't forget to like, subscribe, and comment with any questions you have about properties of determinants!
